name.en: Bedrock pothole with geometric wall and floor
name.zh: 具有真实侧壁与底面的河床壶穴

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: rounded deep cavity drilled into exposed bedrock. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：裸露河床岩石上的深圆穴。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

reconstruction_notes.en: Original continuous bedrock volume with a deep rounded cavity, gently fluted wall, closed floor and one simplified rounded clast. Nominal dimensions, rock palette and cut outline are artistic. Actual geometry, not a painted dark circle; no arbitrary seamless tiling or exact paleo-river reconstruction.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创连续基岩体具有深圆穴、轻微沟纹侧壁、封闭底面与一枚简化圆砾。名义尺寸、岩石配色和裁切边界为美术选择。孔穴使用真实几何，非黑圆贴画；不承诺任意无缝拼接或精确古河床复原。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
